name: Another Century's Revolution
source:
Another Century's Revolution. A fan disk/sequel to MIDNIGHT! Returning to the World of Haze once more, read through six total scenarios (three in the demo) written by three different authors!
____________________________________________________________________________

[i]epilogue -plural marionette-[/i] by sanguineCPU
A little over a decade has passed since the fall of the Seiffen Cluster.

Reine Merveille, the genius engineer of the infamous Merveille Family, has been kidnapped by a lone perpetrator.
Introducing herself as Gwyn The Magician, she only desires one thing...

—The repair of a broken doll.

[i]The threads of past and present are tangled within her hands.[/i]
____________________________________________________________________________

[i]the Bunting and the Butcher[/i] by princess_astertiae
Esper Orto has traveled all over since leaving Ilium Cluster. After years of travel, she has come back to visit her mother, Sesam.  Family reunions, however, often seem to turn to misfortune. 

The bunting returns home seeking absolution. 
The butcher yearns to escape to something real.  

[i]A daughter and mother reminisce on the sins of years past.[/i]
____________________________________________________________________________

[i]51st Target[/i] by homunculesque
The hitman— An apathetic killer, ending lives without prejudice. 
The assassin— A passionate murderer, killing only for herself. 

Two bloodstained paths intersect in the sands of Gehenna. Drawing Espers like moths, a place connected to the divine. The fate of a Cluster in their crimson hands.

[i] —Even if I’m not an Esper, I can change the world.[/i]

[From [url=https://sanguinecpu.itch.io/another-centurys-revolution]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
另一个世纪的革命。粉丝盘/午夜续集！再次回到雾霾世界，通读由三位不同作者编写的总共六个场景（演示中的三个）！
_______________________________________________________________________

[i]epilogue -复数牵线木偶-[/i] by sanguineCPU自塞芬星团崩溃以来已经过去了十多年。

臭名昭著的Merveille家族的天才工程师Reine Merveille被一名单独行凶者绑架。
自我介绍为魔术师格温，她只想要一件事……

——修复破损的娃娃。

[i]过去与现在的丝线在她手中纠缠着。[/i]
_______________________________________________________________________

[i]鹀与屠夫[/i] by princess_astertiae埃斯珀·奥托自从离开髂星团后就已经走遍了世界各地。经过多年的旅行，她回来看望她的母亲芝麻。然而，家庭团聚似乎常常变成不幸。

彩旗回家寻求赦免。
屠夫渴望逃离现实。

[i]A女儿和母亲追忆过去的罪恶。[/i]
_______________________________________________________________________

[i]51st Target[/i] by homunculesque杀手——冷漠的杀手，不带偏见地结束生命。
刺客——一个热血的杀人犯，只为自己而杀人。

两条血迹斑斑的小路在地狱的沙漠中交汇。像飞蛾一样绘制异能者，一个与神相连的地方。集群的命运掌握在他们深红色的手中。

[i] —即使我不是超能力者，我也能改变世界。[/i]

[来自[url=https://sanguinecpu.itch.io/another-centurys-revolution]Itch.io[/url]]
